card.name: Words just before a number or amount
card.fires_on: Small linking words or symbols right before a number in dosing text, such as "no less than", "a total of", "at least", "draw up", "=", or an opening bracket after a dose.

modes.label: Minimum or total phrases
modes.description: The last word of a phrase like "no less than", "total of", or "minimum of" that is followed by a number of hours or days.
modes.example: be delivered over a period of time of no less<< than>> 4 hours. NAGLAZY

modes.label: Unit equivalents and instructions
modes.description: An equals sign, opening bracket, or "draw up" where an equivalent amount or volume comes next.
